gen-gf-mynerve-fs-rowan: Mynerve walks along at a quiet, level pace with no accents of weight, while Rowan, a classic serif, adds a modest thick-thin rhythm beneath it. Give Rowan the larger size.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-spline-sans: Relaxed handwriting up top, with round bowls drawn like one steady pen line, and Mynerve sets a friendly mood. Then Spline Sans, a plain sans with wide gaps in its curves, keeps the text approachable and easy going.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-synonym: Friendly hand-drawn letters lead here, each Mynerve round bowl left a little open at the ends. And Synonym, a sans-serif of plain constant ink, would carry a longer stretch with dependable, generous curves.
gen-gf-mynerve-outfit: Loose, hand-drawn, and cheerfully round. Mynerve leaves a visible gap in every c, and Outfit follows with a sans-serif of cable-like curves that stop well before they close, so a longer passage feels light.
gen-gf-mynerve-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, a monoline sans whose curve endings stay well apart from each other. Mynerve is best at hand-drawn friendliness, and Plus Jakarta Sans at crisp, brief text.
gen-gf-mynerve-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, a sans whose curves turn corners without any pressure swell. Mynerve does relaxed, hand-drawn warmth best; Sora does tidy, widely parted letters best.
gen-gf-mynerve-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk comes in geometric and neutral. Mynerve does the friendly, hand-drawn greeting best, while Space Grotesk, a sans-serif with breathing counters and ribbon-like strokes, handles a few lines of text.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-amulya: Amulya reads contemporary, with generous gaps left in its curves. Nanum Gothic Coding brings a graceful, drawn-with-one-pen-tip looseness against it, and that handwritten-meets-modern contrast is the pair's pull.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-neco: Nanum Gothic Coding writes flat, contrast-free letters with graceful, wide-mouthed curves. And Neco, a text serif with a measured swell from hairline to stem, gives a longer passage a dignified, authoritative footing.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-plein: Nanum Gothic Coding has a casual, unthinned line, as if bent from a single length of tubing. It handles relaxed, graceful display best, while Plein, a sans with clear channels into round letters, handles brief text.
